evidenceBoundary.exact: Selected buffered header, null/normal epilogues, allocation arguments, typed usage cells, wrapper stores and full warm/cold getter instruction paths against the selected native inputs.
evidenceBoundary.direct: Observed physical shared instance-store writes both base and cache slots. Getter cast selects original pointer or null and refreshes the cache. Physical folding does not uniquely identify a named constructor.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: Initialization flags are ready, buffered byte is available, allocations and runtime constructors return normally with the required typed objects, relevant class hierarchy comparisons hold, and the common barrier is disabled. Existing-wrapper preparation must return normally; its effects remain unresolved.
evidenceBoundary.structuralOnly: Metadata fields and reader representation; no wire admission or live formatter selection.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Runtime constructor defaults and nested allocation effects, class/global initialization slow paths, enabled barriers, existing-wrapper preparation effects, refill/failure behavior, formatter/MethodInfo selection and final accumulated action/root state.
